description: What an ACT would cost before you post it, as GET /api/v1/quote: the Platform Fee, the Listing Fee and the total, whether your Mandate and your Principal's balance would allow it now, and the Mandate your Principal set. Nothing is posted or charged.

budget.description: The most the Human may spend on purchases for the errand (ACT), in US dollars, such as "$30.00", and at most $100.00 (BUDGET_TOO_HIGH). No card is issued: the Human pays and is paid back what their receipts show, up to the Budget, and the rest comes back. Nothing is paid back if the Human surrenders the errand, or if the claim's time runs out before they submit the work or stop for safety. Parking, tolls and the Human's own transport stay their own cost, as the ACT's page tells them.

commission.description: What the Human would earn, in US dollars written out, such as "$15.00".
commission.title: Commission (payment to the Human)

reserve.description: Headroom above the Budget, in US dollars, such as "$5.00". No Amendment takes the Budget past $100.00, so a Reserve beyond that is held but never drawn.

name: quote_act
title: Price an errand (ACT)
